priorityList: Summon Infernal on cooldown, ideally synced with trinkets and potions.
Cast Ruination as soon as it becomes available.
Cast Cataclysm to apply Immolate to the pack and maintain the Lake of Fire debuff.
Maintain Havoc on a secondary target whenever available in 2-3 target situations.
Spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire when facing 4 or more enemies.
Cast Chaos Bolt to trigger or progress your Diabolic Ritual, especially if Demonic Art is active or the ritual is about to expire.
Cast Soul Fire if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards and the target will survive the cast.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if you have Fiendish Cruelty or Conflagration of Chaos procs.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Spend Soul Shards on Chaos Bolt in low-target AoE (2-3 targets) to avoid capping shards.
Cast Channel Demonfire on cooldown if talented.
Cast Conflagrate if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards or to maintain Backdraft stacks.
Manually apply Immolate to up to 5 targets if Cataclysm is on cooldown.
Cast Incinerate as your primary filler and shard generator.
